GovScraper Referral Program Terms

Effective November 17, 2026 · MeND Sourcing Solutions LLC ("GovScraper", "we", "us")

These terms govern the GovScraper Referral Program (the "Program"). By sharing your referral link or redeeming one, you agree to these terms and to GovScraper's Terms of Service.

1. Who can refer

  • Any GovScraper member with an active paid subscription in good standing (LITE, PRO, GOLD, or MAXX) may participate.
  • Free CAGE accounts and accounts in trial are not eligible to earn referral credits.
  • Accounts that are past due, suspended, or terminated are not eligible.

2. What your friend gets

  • A new customer who signs up through your referral link receives a 14-day free trial — double the standard 7-day trial.
  • The extended trial applies once per person and per company. Prior members, prior trial users, and existing accounts do not qualify as new customers.

3. What you earn — qualifying referrals

You earn a $100 account credit when all of the following are true:

  • Your friend signs up using your referral link;
  • They subscribe to a PRO, GOLD, or MAXX plan (LITE subscriptions do not trigger the reward); and
  • Their first payment is successfully processed.

The credit is applied automatically to your next invoice. Credits carry no cash value, cannot be transferred, sold, or redeemed for cash, and unused credits expire if your subscription is cancelled or terminated.

4. Clawback

If your friend's first payment is refunded, reversed, or charged back within 30 days, the associated $100 credit is withdrawn. If the credit was already applied to your invoice, the amount may be added to your next bill.

5. Limits

  • You may earn up to $1,000 in referral credits per calendar year (10 qualifying referrals).
  • One reward per referred customer and per referred company, determined by CAGE code, billing identity, or payment method.

6. Prohibited conduct

The following void the related credits and may lead to removal from the Program or account suspension:

  • Self-referrals — referring yourself, your own company, affiliates, or accounts you control, including by CAGE code or payment method.
  • Referring members of the same company or organization as separate "new customers".
  • Spam, bulk unsolicited email or texts, misleading claims about GovScraper, or posting referral links on coupon or voucher sites.
  • Bidding on GovScraper brand terms in paid search, or impersonating GovScraper in ads or domains.

7. Program changes

We may modify, pause, or end the Program at any time. Changes apply prospectively: credits already earned under these terms remain valid, subject to Section 4. Referrals started before a change are honored under the terms in effect when the referred customer signed up.

8. Disputes and decisions

We make reasonable, good-faith determinations about whether a referral qualifies, including fraud reviews. Our determinations are final. Questions about a specific referral: tristan@govscraper.com.
